thesis: The episode introduces Mike Tian, a portfolio manager at WCM Investment Management, who discusses his background as a former Morningstar analyst and his focus on moat trajectories and emerging markets. The conversation covers his application of moat analysis to China, including heavy industries and culture, as well as the firm's own moat trajectory.
